hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Harmonious teal/brown palette and clean card layout show design intent, but the visualization is cropped at the bottom cutting off the circle pack, and dark edge bundles create heavy visual noise that obscures the node structure.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Encoding is structurally honest — scaleSqrt correctly used for force-layout circle sizing, d3.pack handles circle area, domains are data-driven via d3.extent, and primary data joins carry key functions; the only gap is the hierarchy links join (.data(root.links())) lacks a key function, risking DOM corruption on re-render.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing/amplitude sliders fire full updateLayout() (1500ms transition) on every input event with no debounce; tension slider calls redrawLinks() on all 300 paths per pixel without RAF coalescing; no .interrupt() before new transitions; mouseover/mouseout lack touch-event filtering.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The two-color group separation (teal vs tan) is perceptually clear, but 200 nodes with dense bundled edges converging in the Circle Pack center produces a hairball tangle that obscures individual connections; 7 switchable layouts with Flubber morph transitions add substantial animation complexity that cannot be evaluated from a static screenshot but risks severe object-constancy failure at this node count.
